integrity: The entire character is checked exactly from signed fixed-face traces, an exhaustive finite acyclic matching, and internally constructed irreducible characters. This is a mathematical same-model review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The new theorem determines the rational B3 homology representation and orbit-space rational cohomology ring only; the 675-sphere nonequivariant homotopy type was already established, and integral equivariant structure is not determined.
title: The full hyperoctahedral homology character of the octahedral-graph Morse complex
